thread:
Deploy-bot: starting staged rollout v2.4.1 -> 10% (eu-west1) per change window 10:00-11:00PT
Alex: heads up — shift started, watch dashboards & logs. tagging @Jamie @Nina
Deploy-bot: traffic routing updated: v2.4.1=10%, v2.3.9=90%
Jamie: seeing an uptick in structured-response failures in the canary set: baseline 0.8% -> 4.2% in last 3 min
SRE-bot: cadence alert: downstream reranker latency x3 on canary hosts
Nina: product reports chat formatting issues from QA: missing closing tags in some responses
Jamie: logs snippet: ```ERROR JSONParse: unexpected '}' in response at pos 123\nstack: model_output::format->sanitize```
Alex: ok — we need a quick decision. options: full rollback to v2.3.9, reduce traffic (soft-stop), or pin region and triage. thoughts?
Product-ops: user-facing formatting regression confirmed on ~5 QA sessions, impacts table rendering in replies
Alex: propose soft-stop -> scale canary to 2% while we investigate. keep canary live for traces. Support and on-call should be prepped for rollback if needed
Jamie: +1. will start trace capture and run a minimal escaping hotfix branch (hf/escape-quote). building now.
Support: notifying CS and support rotations. updating the incident matrix if we escalate.
Deploy-bot: executing traffic shift: v2.4.1 -> 2% in eu-west1 (now 2%)
Alex: set acceptance gating: errors <1% for 15m -> resume; errors >3% -> rollback to v2.3.9 and declare incident
Jamie: built image hf-20260320-01, running smoke tests against canary hosts (ETA ~12m)
Nina: I'll prepare a short release-note update and an internal heads-up: "known formatting regression in v2.4.1; mitigating"
Jamie: smoke results: small sample passed, still seeing intermittent parse failures in long responses
Alex: good to keep at 2% for now. Support, please prep rollback runbook; Jamie, continue triage and get hotfix deployed to canary once validated
Support: rollback runbook ready, standby. I've posted steps in #incidents and linked to runbook doc.
Jamie: deploying hf-20260320-01 to canary now: `/deploy promote --image hf-20260320-01 --target canary --region eu-west1`
Deploy-bot: promotion queued; will confirm when traffic flips.
Deploy-bot: promotion complete, canary now running hf-20260320-01 at 2%
Jamie: initial signs look better, parser errors down to 0.6% in the 5m window
Alex: maintain 2% until we have 15m of <1% — then we'll follow ramp plan: 2% -> 10% -> 30% over 30m increments. If any regression reappears we stop and rollback. Document the decision and the pinned fallback (v2.3.9)
Nina: changelog note drafted and sent to #release-notes; flagged as "hotfix pending verification"
Product-ops: alerting PM and QA to validate formatting on broader prompt sets
Support: CS notified, prepared postmortem template if we escalate.
Alex: thanks everyone — call remains open. I'll post final go/no-go after the 15m stability check. :thumbsup:
